outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of fluorescence micrographs (MitoTracker, DsRed, GFP, merge), not a plot of averaged data.
The bottom of panel B contains bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity) showing group means with error bars (n=20) but no overlaid individual data points.
Panel C is a Western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D includes bar charts of SDH and COX signal intensity with error bars and sample sizes (N) noted in the bars, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.

Panel E shows FACS histograms of TMRM intensity distributions (cell counts vs. fluorescence intensity), which display the full data distribution similarly to a line/frequency plot rather than a bar chart of means, so individual data point overlay is not applicable.
